lime-volt.$description: Lime Volt — Hero backgrounds, pill button fill, category tag backgrounds — the single most identifiable brand signal; vivid green against dark ink creates energy no fintech blue could achieve

forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — Primary text, dark headlines on lime, nav links, icon fills — deep forest green instead of black keeps everything on-brand even at body size

volt-yellow.$description: Volt Yellow — Accent headlines, decorative text color on dark backgrounds — electric yellow that pairs with deep burgundy for maximum punch

papaya.$description: Papaya — Warm accent card backgrounds, decorative section highlights

cotton-candy.$description: Cotton Candy — Soft accent backgrounds, section highlights in the mosaic grid

aubergine-night.$description: Aubergine Night — Dark card backgrounds, high-contrast panels in the content grid — deep purple-black that isn't neutral

crimson-depth.$description: Crimson Depth — Dark editorial backgrounds, heading color on light panels — near-black red that reads as richly dark without being neutral

fog.$description: Fog — Secondary body text, border colors, UI chrome

white.$description: White — Page backgrounds, card surfaces, section backgrounds between color blocks

positive.$description: Positive — Success states, positive transaction indicators

negative.$description: Negative — Error states, negative transaction indicators

accent-blue.$description: Accent Blue — Interactive accent links, focus states

warning.$description: Warning — Warning states, attention-needed transaction labels

inter.$description: All UI text: nav links, body copy, subheadings, and medium display text. Weight 400 for body, 600 for subheadings and labels. The 'ss01' feature setting and negative letter-spacing at large sizes (-0.03em at 72px down to -0.005em at 22px) keep it tight without feeling condensed.

wise-sans.$description: Hero and section display headlines exclusively. Weight 900 at 0.85 line-height is the defining typographic move — lines of text stack so tightly the cap-height of one line nearly touches the descender zone of the line above, creating billboard-compressed stacked type. This is the visual signature of the design system.

zen-kaku-gothic-new.$description: Single-use mega-display for CJK character showcase — demonstrates multilingual typographic range of the system
